documentation.content: The API has been answering 503 (`api.upstream_unavailable`) more than 25 times per 5 minutes for 10 minutes. Yahoo throttling comes and goes; a rate that holds is usually one route asking for a symbol Yahoo will never answer (2026-09: bare EU broker codes made every portfolio call raise). Triage: `uv run stocks logs stats --since 1h --event api.upstream_unavailable --by path` for the routes, then `uv run stocks logs tail --since 6h --event yahoo.unlisted` and `--event yahoo.bulk_refused` for the symbols.
